page_pipeline.name: ModelPortfolios
page_pipeline.primary_source: Yang PKL workspace: opal-data-portal-v2/benchmarks/data_YYYYMMDD_v1.pkl AUM time series: SmartX EC2 exporter -> DynamoDB (via opal-smartx-ingestion-pipeline Lambda)
page_pipeline.trigger: Benchmark/ETF/peer data: S3 ObjectCreated on opal-data-portal-v2/benchmarks/*.pkl, or Step Functions YangDataPipeline. AUM data: SmartX EC2 daily export.
page_pipeline.versioning: Yang uses a PKL versioning convention (data_YYYYMMDD_v1.pkl). opal-portal-data-proxy serves the latest versioned data through a /v1/ API namespace. Portal uses LATEST.json pointer at benchmarks/LATEST.json to locate current data PKL.

page_pipeline.name: AdvisorIntelligence
page_pipeline.primary_source: 49 Financial allocation and transaction raw files from Black Diamond Wealth Platform. Ingested via bd-allocation-trigger and bd-transactions-trigger Lambdas. Processed through silver layer (bd-transaction-consolidator) into gold parquets by bd-gold-layer-runner EC2 (scripts pulled from s3://opal-data-bd/code/gold/).
page_pipeline.trigger: Gold parquet completion signaled by opal-data-bd/gold/pipeline-complete.json. This sentinel triggers both bd-portal-publisher and bd-portal-advisor-publisher (parallel execution).
page_pipeline.gold_stage_inputs_to_publishers:
bd-portal-publisher reads: gold/client_performance.parquet (per-relationship daily cumulative AUA/flows) gold/views/nna_aua_by_advisor.parquet (per-architect daily AUA/flows aggregates) gold/views/nna_aua_by_geography.parquet (per-state/country daily AUA aggregates) gold/views/nna_aua_by_geography_city.parquet (per-city daily AUA — optional, graceful skip if absent) gold/client_dimension.parquet (per-relationship metadata: first_seen_date, primary_architect/implementor/state) gold/accounts_dimension_latest.parquet (per-account latest: account_id, relationship_id, architect, implementor, tax_status, qualified_flag, client_state) gold/views/client_tax_liability.parquet (per-relationship tax lot exposure: qualified/non-qualified, cost_basis, unrealized_gain by purchase_year)
bd-portal-advisor-publisher reads: gold/account_performance.parquet (~350MB, ~10M rows — per-account daily cumulative AUA/flows) gold/views/client_tax_liability.parquet (shared with publisher) gold/client_dimension.parquet (shared with publisher) gold/holdings_lots/{YYYYMMDD}.parquet (latest snapshot, per-lot open lot detail)

bd-portal-publisher writes to opal-data-bd: gold/timeseries_chart.json (CumulativeChartResponse) gold/architect_leaderboard.json (LeaderboardResponse) gold/clients_tab.json (ClientsTabResponse) gold/summary/header_metrics.json (HeaderMetricsResponse) gold/partner_analytics/header_metrics.json (PartnerAnalyticsResponse) gold/filters/dimensions.json (FiltersResponse) gold/snapshots/aua_by_architect.json (SnapshotResponse) gold/snapshots/aua_by_state.json (SnapshotResponse) gold/snapshots/aua_by_tax_status.json (SnapshotResponse) gold/snapshots/aua_by_region.json (SnapshotResponse)

page_pipeline.routing: All static JSON served via CloudFront -> S3 with firm-level routing by shared-advisor-router Lambda. portal-authorizer Lambda validates JWT and injects allowedFirmIds into request context. bd-client-detail is invoked by API Gateway (admin-only, not via static S3).

bd_gold_inputs.note: BD gold scripts are stored in S3 at s3://opal-data-bd/code/gold/ and are NOT in the local repository. The bd-gold-layer-runner EC2 syncs scripts from that S3 path at boot (run-gold-layer.sh:62). The scripts below are inferred from the parquet key patterns the publisher Lambdas read. Script names follow the convention observed in the legacy bd-gold-layer Lambda (01_build_canonical_timeline.py, etc.) but the current runner uses a newer set of scripts producing the parquets documented here.

gold_script.name: (produces) gold/client_performance.parquet
gold_script.description: Per-relationship daily cumulative AUA, aua_taxable, aua_tax_deferred, aua_tax_exempt, cum_inflows, cum_outflows, nna, num_accounts, num_positions, pct_priced. Primary performance grain consumed by bd-portal-publisher for all AUA/NNA calculations.

gold_script.name: (produces) gold/views/nna_aua_by_advisor.parquet
gold_script.description: Per-architect daily AUA/flows aggregation: date, architect, total_aua, aua_taxable, aua_tax_deferred, aua_tax_exempt, cum_inflows, cum_outflows, nna, num_relationships, num_accounts. Drives ADV view in timeseries_chart.json, architect_leaderboard.json, and PartnerAnalyticsResponse.views.adv.

gold_script.name: (produces) gold/views/nna_aua_by_geography.parquet
gold_script.description: Per-state/country daily AUA aggregation: date, state, country, total_aua, cum_inflows, cum_outflows, nna, num_relationships, num_accounts. Drives GEO view in timeseries_chart.json, aua_by_state.json snapshot, and PartnerAnalyticsResponse.views.geo.

gold_script.name: (produces) gold/views/nna_aua_by_geography_city.parquet
gold_script.description: Per-city daily AUA aggregation: date, state, city, total_aua, cum_inflows, cum_outflows, nna, num_relationships. Drives geo_drill sub-view in timeseries_chart.json (optional — gracefully skipped if absent). Maximum 9 cities per state in output.

gold_script.name: (produces) gold/client_dimension.parquet
gold_script.description: Per-relationship static metadata: relationship_id, relationship_name, first_seen_date, primary_architect, primary_implementor, primary_state, primary_country, total_accounts, active_accounts, has_taxable, has_tax_deferred, has_tax_exempt. Used for new-client classification (first_seen_date), PartnerAnalyticsResponse client counts, and engagement/tenure metrics.

gold_script.name: (produces) gold/accounts_dimension_latest.parquet
gold_script.description: Per-account latest metadata: account_id, relationship_id, account_name, architect, implementor, local_relationship, tax_status, qualified_flag, client_state, client_country, account_type, account_is_open. Used for filters/dimensions.json and snapshot snapshots (region, account_type).

gold_script.name: (produces) gold/views/client_tax_liability.parquet
gold_script.description: Per-relationship tax lot exposure from holdings data: relationship_id, account_id, tax_status, qualified_flag, asset_name, ticker, purchase_year, total_units, total_cost_basis, total_market_value, total_accrued_gain, short_term_cost_basis, short_term_market_value, short_term_gain, long_term_cost_basis, long_term_market_value, long_term_gain, num_open_lots. Drives all tax sections in clients_tab.json, advisor book.json, and client detail. Note: labeled "Yang's fields" in publisher code — these fields were originally sourced from Yang/SmartX lot data but are now produced by the BD gold pipeline from BD holdings.

gold_script.name: (produces) gold/account_performance.parquet
gold_script.description: Per-account daily cumulative AUA/flows (large file: ~350MB, ~10M rows). Columns: date, account_id, relationship_id, architect, implementor, tax_status, total_aua, cum_inflows, cum_outflows, nna, num_positions. Separated into bd-portal-advisor-publisher to avoid OOM with other tables in a single Lambda. Drives implementor_leaderboard.json and per-advisor book.json.

gold_script.name: (produces) gold/holdings_lots/{YYYYMMDD}.parquet
gold_script.description: Per-lot snapshot for open taxable positions. Per-lot columns include: relationship_id, account_id, account_name, asset_name, ticker, acquisition_date, purchase_year, lot_index, current_units, cost_per_unit, cost_basis, current_price, market_value, accrued_gain, holding_period_days, term, tax_status, is_open. Drives open_lots[] array in ClientDetailResponse (bd-portal-advisor-publisher uses latest snapshot).

gold_script.name: (produces) gold/pipeline-complete.json
gold_script.description: Sentinel file written at the end of the gold layer run by bd-gold-layer-runner EC2. Triggers bd-portal-publisher and bd-portal-advisor-publisher via S3 ObjectCreated event. Both publishers run in parallel. Content is a simple completion timestamp/status marker.

dependency.item: Yang PKL workspace (opal-data-portal-v2/benchmarks/): model portfolio and benchmark return_daily DataFrames. Source: Yang quantitative engine running on EC2 or local, uploads PKL files to S3.
SmartX EC2 exporter: AUM time series source. Persistent EC2 instance (smartx-exporter) that exports SmartX portfolio data daily. Data stored in DynamoDB tables consumed by opal-portal-data-proxy.
Bloomberg indices: Used as benchmark components (Bloomberg Agg, 0-1 Year Treasury, MSCI ACWI). Embedded in Yang PKL return_daily data.
Morningstar peer universe: Peer comparison data embedded in Yang PKL or produced by yang-generate-peer-performance (source not confirmed from code alone).
49 Financial raw allocation files: Uploaded by Black Diamond Wealth Platform, ingested by bd-allocation-trigger Lambda.
49 Financial raw transaction files: Ingested by bd-transactions-trigger Lambda.
BD silver layer: bd-transaction-consolidator Lambda processes raw files into silver/bd_transactions.parquet and silver/bd_accounts.parquet in opal-data-bd.

BD gold layer runner EC2 (bd-gold-layer-runner): Persistent EC2 that pulls scripts from s3://opal-data-bd/code/gold/ and produces all gold parquets. Scripts are managed separately from the local repository.
opal-data-bd S3 bucket: Central storage for all BD pipeline data (silver, gold parquets, published JSON, logs).
opal-data-portal-v2 S3 bucket: Some static JSON (e.g. advisor_rolling_flows.json per pod_inventory) may be written here by bd-portal-publisher (bucket routing not fully confirmed from code).

data_quality_notes.note: AUA UNDERCOUNT HISTORY (Feb 23-27 2026 sprint): An AUA undercount incident was resolved in the Feb 23-27 sprint. The publisher was rearchitected to read from gold/client_performance.parquet (position-based AUA at relationship grain) instead of the older transaction-based approach. The parquets (nna_aua_by_advisor.parquet, nna_aua_by_geography.parquet, client_performance.parquet) are the canonical AUA source. Any historical data before this sprint may reflect the undercount. Code comments reference "Yang's fields" in tax sections, acknowledging that qualified/non-qualified lot data was previously sourced differently.

FIRM ID AUTH REFACTOR PENDING: getSnapshot() and related opal-partners-data endpoints currently pass firmId as a query parameter. Code comment: "firmId will be removed once Lambda reads from portal-authorizer context (authorizer.lambda.firmId) instead." Auth refactor is pending.

DEMO MODE ENDPOINT (ModelPortfolios account distribution): getAccountDistribution() uses a public endpoint /api/general/portfolios/account-distribution.json with no authentication. TODO comment in source: "Revert to private endpoint for production." Data may not reflect actual production state.

401 REDIRECT DISABLED (ModelPortfolios): The redirect-to-login on 401 Unauthorized response is disabled in portal-proxy.ts. Was causing an infinite redirect loop for the ModelPortfolios page. Currently logs the error but does not redirect. Auth failure is silent to the user.

ZERO-FILLED FIELDS (AdvisorIntelligence): income_fees (dividends, interest, management fees, fee_rate_pct) and portfolio.allocation are consistently zeroed across all BD publisher outputs. BD transaction data does not contain income/fee information or asset class taxonomy. These fields exist in the response schema for future compatibility but carry no current data.

TAX FIELD LABELING ("Yang's fields"): Fields such as qualified_aua, non_qualified_aua, cost_basis_by_year, and top_gain_positions are labeled "Yang's fields" in publisher comments. This reflects their origin: they were originally populated from Yang/SmartX holdings lot data. The current implementation derives them from BD holdings via gold/views/client_tax_liability.parquet. The label is historical and does not indicate a live Yang dependency in the BD publisher.

GOLD SCRIPTS NOT IN LOCAL REPO: BD gold pipeline scripts are stored in s3://opal-data-bd/code/gold/ and synced to the EC2 at boot. The local repository does not contain the gold Python scripts. Any changes to gold script logic require uploading to S3 directly (following EC2_CODE_DEPLOYMENT_STANDARD.md).

LEGACY TAB (AdvisorIntelligence): AssetIntelligenceTab.tsx exists in the portal directory but is not wired to the v5 AdvisorIntelligence.tsx tab navigation. Likely legacy code from a prior version. Verify before modifying or deleting.

IMPLEMENTOR UNASSIGNED HANDLING: The implementor_leaderboard normalizes several null-equivalent strings to "Unassigned": empty string, "nan", "None", "No Implementor Value Assigned". The portal must handle "Unassigned" as a valid leaderboard entry.
